scope: Initial source-reviewed entries only. S1 inventory and classification remain incomplete.

reviews.declarator:
DX8Caps::DX8Caps(IDirect3D8 *direct3d, const D3DCAPS8 &caps,
	WW3DFormat display_format, const D3DADAPTER_IDENTIFIER8 &adapter_id)
reviews.original_owner: DX8Caps original Direct3D hardware enumeration and DX8Wrapper capability consumers
reviews.behavior: Replaces Windows device enumeration with a conservative fixed native description. Z bias, bump environment maps, anisotropic filtering, native shader versions and render-to-texture formats are advertised unavailable; only the listed texture operations are advertised. This classification does not establish that all needed renderer features are mapped.
callers: Global g_vita_caps construction and DX8Wrapper::CurrentCaps binding in the same native boundary
affected_scope: All native modes using original DX8Wrapper capability queries; effects affected by unavailable features require S2 and all-map data closure
reviews.acceptance_open: Reconcile every original queried capability with actual Vita submission support and physical effects. Native source selection and fixed capability flags do not prove feature completeness.

reviews.behavior: Returns NULL for every size and format, with one native diagnostic. No offscreen target is allocated. The original fallback avoids submitting an offscreen draw but does not restore render-to-texture.
affected_scope: All modes reaching original projector render-target allocation; per-map instances remain unverified
reviews.acceptance_open: Original target allocation, binding, projected shadows and rendered results on Vita/PSTV. Source caller evidence is not physical acceptance.

reviews.original_owner: MeshClass additional material passes; AABoxRenderObjClass and OBBoxRenderObjClass rendering
reviews.behavior: Increments diagnostic statistics and logs the first object; submits no geometry or material pass.
affected_scope: Modes reaching additional mesh passes or enabled box display masks; per-map instances and display-mask settings remain unverified
reviews.acceptance_open: Additional-pass and box submission ownership, build-profile reachability and native pixels. Box-display diagnostic use is not proof of retail exclusion.

reviews.behavior: Diagnostic counter and first-operation logging only. Current staged callers are guarded by RENEGADE_VITA_PORT && !__vita__; their presence does not prove native decals are still skipped.
affected_scope: Host port profiles taking the non-__vita__ decal guard; native decal restoration and depth-bias results remain separate open gates
reviews.acceptance_open: Native decal queue/body/flush execution and depth-bias presentation, plus explicit host profile selection. Do not classify the native path from this diagnostic helper alone.

reviews.original_owner: BINKMovie playback provider beneath original MovieGameModeClass and movie-options dialog
reviews.behavior: Fallback branch records lifecycle or skip diagnostics, returns immediate completion or performs no work; it does not decode or present movie audio/video. Current native FFmpeg profile selects the alternative branch.
affected_scope: Host and native configurations lacking both __vita__ and RENEGADE_A4_BINK_FFMPEG; frontend and campaign movie routes. Full native FFmpeg profile excludes this branch; physical playback remains unverified.
reviews.acceptance_open: Verify build-profile selection and linked owner across all supported configurations; retain native A/V timing and playback acceptance as separate gates.
